jobs.description:
### **Description**

We are looking for a dedicated and enthusiastic Software Engineer with 2-4 years of experience to join our product development team. The candidate will understand customer requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and complete assigned development work with quality and ownership. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Java and SQL, a working understanding of JavaScript and APIs, and strong communication and collaboration skills. Knowledge or work experience in AI/ML and prior experience in a product-based company will be an added advantage.

  

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Understanding customer requirements and converting them into clear technical tasks and software solutions.
* Designing, developing, unit testing, debugging, and maintaining HRT application
* Working with JavaScript, REST APIs, web services, and system integrations.
* Collaborating with Product Managers, Business Analysts, QA engineers, and other developers to complete requirements.
* Participating in design discussions, code reviews, defect analysis, and technical problem-solving.
* Using Git for source-code management and Jira for work tracking and Agile delivery.
* Following the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), coding standards, and team development processes.
* Investigating customer-reported issues and delivering timely, reliable fixes.
* Learning new technologies and adapting to new responsibilities, tools, and ways of working.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree (B.Tech/B.E.) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 2-4 years of professional software development experience.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Strong programming knowledge and hands-on development experience in Java and system design concepts.
* Good knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and database concepts.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript and web application fundamentals.
* Understanding of REST APIs, request/response flows, web services, integrations, and how distributed application components work together.
* Experience with Git for version control and Jira for issue and work tracking.
* Good understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum development practices. Understanding of AWS concepts.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to understand customer needs and deliver completed solutions with quality and accountability.
* Dedication, enthusiasm to learn, and willingness to adopt and work with new technologies.

jobs.title: Product manager
jobs.description:
Company: VSP AI and Robotics

Location: Hyderabad, full time, in office

Reports to: CEO & Chairman

Experience: 5+ years The role You lead the engineering of about ten live and new products, with a team of about ten developers. You make the technical decisions, keep each product moving, and make sure what we ship works. You use AI coding agents every day: agents review, fix and merge most pull requests, and you direct them and check their work. Products you will own Business software: ERP, CRM and HRMS on Frappe, with a Flutter mobile app. Booking platforms for resorts and coworking spaces (Flutter, Supabase, Razorpay). A hosted business phone service on Telnyx (FastAPI, React, Flutter softphone). A live operations platform for an NGO with field staff in 29 mandals. Vikky, our voice AI assistant (LiveKit, realtime voice models, LLM agents) and its ESP32 speaker. An AI news-video engine, a family finance app, and new client projects. What you do Set the technical direction and the priorities for each product, with the founders and the clients. Review and merge code, mostly through AI agents; fix critical problems yourself. Keep production healthy: deployments, CI/CD, AWS (Mumbai), monitoring, backups and costs. Turn client conversations into clear issues, specs and plans. Guide the developers: they build new features, test on real devices and work with the stakeholders. Keep the trackers (GitHub Projects) current and report status every week. You have Real production experience as a full-stack engineer, and experience as a lead of a small team. Strong Python and TypeScript. Working knowledge of Flutter and SQL (PostgreSQL). Experience with AWS, Docker, Linux and GitHub Actions. Daily use of AI coding agents (for example Claude Code or Codex), and the judgment to check their output. Clear written English. You explain technical trade-offs to people who are not engineers. Good to have Frappe or ERPNext, Supabase, Telnyx or other telephony APIs. Voice AI (WebRTC, LiveKit, speech models) or ESP32 firmware. Indian payments and GST invoicing (Razorpay).

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹2,320,000.00 per month

* Hands-on experience with Jira and agile product development/software delivery lifecycle practices

* Domain expertise in Business Banking

* Knowledge of Business Banking account opening and shopping flows and underlying services

jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**This is a hybrid role based in our Hyderabad office. You’ll work from the office 2–3 days a week.**

**About the Role**
------------------

You will work closely with product managers, architects, designers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality features. You will also contribute to our AI-enabled engineering practices by using modern development tools, automation, and AI-assisted workflows to improve productivity, quality, and delivery speed.

---------------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong programming experience in one or more relevant technologies such as Java, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or similar.
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs, webhooks, and integrating with internal or external services.
* Strong understanding of unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and performance optimisation.
* Experience working with Git and modern CI/CD practices.

**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
* 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 1 year of experience in technical leadership.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
Google Pay is one of the leading UPI apps in India. Our mission is to make payments and commerce simple, fast, and reliable to unlock a brighter financial future for everyone in India. We aim to provide affordable access to financial services across the region. Specifically, Google Pay aims to enable users to participate in the digital economy with confidence by providing a simple, secure, and trusted financial platform. The overall goal is to reduce transaction friction and enhance everyday financial experiences.
  
  
Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

* Work with partner teams (e.g., engineers, PgMs, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn PRDs into OKRs for one or more teams.

jobs.title: Product Owner III
jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

  

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**
  

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

  

This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.

  

As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.

  

This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
  
* Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories
  
* Help define and evolve requirements for MEM's publishing engine — how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
  
* As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives
  
  

  
**Qualifications:**
  

  
* Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) — writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred
  
* Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform
  
* Comfort defining requirements for a 0-to-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows
  
* Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering-ready PRDs
  
* Familiarity with mobile-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus
  
* Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  
* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  
* Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
At Techdome, we turn AI ambition into enterprise-grade products. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists build LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Every product ships with the integrations, security, and compliance that enterprise clients demand.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Anyone can get a GenAI prototype working in a weekend. The hard part is everything after: passing a security review, staying inside budget, keeping costs per query sane, and earning the trust of real users.
  
  
We’re looking for a Product Manager who treats that hard part as the real job. You’ll own products end to end, from the first client conversation through launch and long-term growth, and you’ll be the person who spots the vague requirement, the missed handoff, or the quiet risk while it’s still cheap to fix.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Product vision and scope**

* Shape a client’s idea into a clear product definition with realistic milestones, timelines, and budgets.
* Go deep on each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance obligations, and convert them into requirements engineers can build from without guessing.

**Taking GenAI from prototype to production**

* Partner with ML engineers to harden LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, and safe systems.
* Define the metrics that matter in production, including accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query, and review them continuously.
* Make sure every AI feature integrates cleanly with client systems via APIs and meets enterprise expectations for security, data privacy, and uptime.

**Leading across disciplines**

* Align UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so handoffs are explicit and nothing relies on assumption.
* Plan team capacity and keep every party accountable to their commitments.
* Manage third-party partners, including LLM and cloud providers.

**Managing risk, change, and communication**

* Run structured change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget shifts.
* Surface and escalate delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and runaway costs.
* Track work in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership clear, no-surprise updates.
* Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager shipping complex enterprise software on time and on budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having launched at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, plus a solid grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks.

* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including with senior client executives.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost-optimization practices.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Deep domain expertise in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Experience across industries and the curiosity to pick up a new one fast.

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Day 30: You know how Techdome delivers, you’ve met the team, and you’re up to speed on active client projects.
* Day 60: You independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.
* Day 90: You land a key milestone, make a visible improvement to how we run projects, and have earned the trust of both team and clients.

**What’s In It For You**

* Technically demanding GenAI work across multiple industries.
* Daily collaboration with seasoned designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* A genuine say in how projects are planned, run, and delivered.
* Room to build deep expertise at the frontier of GenAI.

In this role, you will serve as the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens—determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories with clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define what success looks like for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience in Product Management, including defining Product Vision and owning the Product Roadmap
* Expertise in Agile or SAFe frameworks, with extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments
* Understanding of AI Solutions, AI Content Framework, and AI Risk Management
* Knowledge of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
* Familiarity with function calling and multi-agent orchestration concepts (no coding required, but strong conceptual grasp is essential)
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the ROI of automation features
* Capability to manage product lifecycles for non-deterministic software where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable
* Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Showcase of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases using an MVP approach
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager for data science, machine learning, or generative AI products
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst - AI Framework
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded **Product Owner (PO) for AI & Agentic Products** to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of our AI-driven product portfolio. In this role, you will be the bridge between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.

You must possess a deep understanding of business domains alongside a strong technical grounding in Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), and autonomous agent workflows. Working closely with our AI Development Lead, you will translate high-level business requirements into granular user stories, actively participate in building Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure the engineering team is building AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business leaders, domain experts, and end-users to discover, define, and document comprehensive business requirements
* Evaluate business problems through an AI lens — determining whether a problem is best solved via deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows
* Define, maintain, and communicate the product roadmap, balancing short-term business wins with long-term technical architecture sustainability
* Partner with the AI Development Lead to deconstruct high-level product features into comprehensive Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)
* Write highly descriptive, value-driven Epics and User Stories. Define clear Acceptance Criteria that account for the non-deterministic nature of AI outputs
* Own, groom, and prioritize the product backlog based on ROI, user impact, and technical dependencies defined by the engineering lead
* Translate complex business rules and industry domain knowledge into logic that AI engineers can use to build agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Work with the engineering team to define "what success looks like" for AI agents, helping establish performance benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and user feedback loops
* Actively participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews, acting as the ultimate voice of the customer

**Requirements**

* Solid conceptual understanding of Generative AI, LLM capabilities (e.g., Google Gemini ecosystem), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), function calling, and multi-agent orchestration. You don't need to code it, but you must know how it works
* Proven ability to map business processes, identify operational bottlenecks, and quantify the return on investment (ROI) of automation features
* Comfort with managing product lifecycles for non-deterministic software (where AI outputs are not always 100% predictable)
* Extensive experience working as a Product Owner in Scrum or Kanban environments, using tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
* Proven track record of breaking down complex enterprise requirements into logical, incremental software delivery phases (MVP approach)
* Exceptional ability to explain technical AI constraints to business users and business nuances to technical engineers

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager for data science, machine learning, or generative AI products
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation
* Background in Business Analysis or Systems Analysis with a later specialization in AI/ML products

jobs.title: Technical Lead – Python | GST & Business Software
jobs.description:
**About us**

Nylun Global Private Limited is building **GST Pilot**, a GST compliance and business software for businesses and Chartered Accountant firms across India. It will cover **GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, IMS (Invoice Management System), ITC reconciliation, e-invoice, e-way bill, GST ledgers and reports**.

**Where we are today:** the core modules have been developed as an **advanced working prototype**: a Windows desktop application (Python + Flask) with a cloud licensing and payments system. Our next goal is to make it a **stable, secure, production-ready product** and launch it to the market, then extend it into a **cloud (SaaS) workspace**. More products will follow, including audit and accounting software.

This is the **most exciting stage to join**: you’ll shape the product, the architecture and the team from the ground up.

**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for a **young, energetic and hands-on Technical Lead** who is:

* **hungry for an opportunity to prove themselves**, and wants to take a product from prototype to launch,
* **ambitious to grow** with a fast-growing company and take on bigger responsibility,
* **passionate about technology and AI**, and always learning new tools and better ways of working,
* **a natural leader**, who enjoys teaching, guiding and growing interns and freshers,
* **an owner, not just an employee**, who takes responsibility for results, not only tasks.

If you have the skills and the fire to grow, and you want a place where your work is **seen, valued and rewarded**, this role is for you.

**What you will do**

* **Take GST Pilot from prototype to production:** review the existing code, find gaps, and make the product **stable, secure, tested and ready for real users**.
* **Plan and prioritise:** turn the product roadmap into clear technical tasks and timelines, and track them to completion.
* **Build hands-on** with **Python (Flask), JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQLite** and a Windows desktop app (WebView2).
* **Strengthen quality:** add automated tests, fix bugs, handle errors properly, and improve reliability and performance.
* **Prepare for launch:** Windows installer, code signing, updates, live payment integration (Razorpay), email and SMS OTP, server setup and security.
* **Improve user experience:** fast loading, correct layout on all screen sizes, smooth handling of large data, good performance on older computers.
* **GST portal integration:** make browser automation and API sessions reliable and secure.
* **Build the cloud version next:** multi-user APIs, PostgreSQL database, secure sync between desktop and cloud, user roles and permissions.
* **Lead with AI:** use AI coding tools every day (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) and build AI-assisted ways of working for the whole team.
* **Lead the team:** plan and assign work to interns and freshers, review their code, train them and help them become productive quickly.
* **Work with our Chartered Accountants:** turn GST and business requirements into accurate, working features.
* **Grow with us:** help plan and build new products as the company expands.

**Must-have skills**

* **6–8 years** of hands-on software development experience.
* **Strong Python**, our core product language, plus experience in **at least one more backend language** such as Node.js, Go, Java or C#/.NET.
* **Backend frameworks:** Flask, FastAPI, Django, Express/NestJS, Gin or similar; good REST API design.
* **Frontend:** JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS; any of vanilla JS, React, Angular or Vue.
* **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL and/or SQLite; good SQL and data-modelling skills.
* **Experience taking software to production:** testing, release, deployment, monitoring and fixing live issues.
* **SaaS / cloud:** experience building or supporting a multi-user cloud application (login, user roles, hosting on AWS, Azure, GCP or Linux servers).
* **AI-first working:** **proactive, daily use of AI coding tools**, with real examples of finishing work faster, and the judgement to check and correct AI-generated code.
* **Team leadership:** experience **guiding interns, freshers or junior developers**: task planning, code reviews, training.
* **Quality:** automated testing (pytest or similar), Git, clean coding practices.
* **Security basics:** encryption, safe storage of passwords and credentials, authentication, input validation.
* Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus.

**Good to have**

* **GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience**: GSTR-1/3B/9, ITC reconciliation, e-invoice, e-way bill, GST portal or GSP APIs.
* **Desktop/Windows applications:** WebView2, Electron, Tauri, .NET WinForms/WPF, PyInstaller/Nuitka, installers (Inno Setup, MSI).
* **Browser automation:** Selenium, Playwright or Puppeteer.
* **Integrations:** payment gateways, SMS gateways (DLT), email services, OAuth / Google sign-in.
* **DevOps:** Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), Linux server management.
* **Others:** Redis or MongoDB, message queues, Kubernetes, mobile (Flutter / React Native).
* **Startup experience:** taking a product from idea or prototype to first customers.

**No GST knowledge? No problem.** Our Chartered Accountants will train you on the GST rules. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn.

**What we are NOT looking for**

* Someone who only wants to manage and no longer writes code.
* Someone who wants to throw everything away and restart from scratch. We build on the work already done, improving and completing it carefully.
* Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job. We want people who want to **build, prove and grow**.

**Why join Nylun Global Private Limited**

* **Build a product from prototype to launch:** see your work go live with businesses and CA firms across India.
* **A real opportunity to prove yourself:** your decisions shape the product, the architecture and the team.
* **Fast growth:** a fast path to senior leadership roles for …

* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects to guide development teams migrating legacy monolithic codebases into modern cloud-native (AWS, Azure, or GCP) microservices
* Provide high-level technical oversight for teams delivering in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate) or .NET (.NET Core, .NET 8+, C#, ASP.NET Web API)
* Champion continuous improvement in delivery pipelines, driving automated testing, robust CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and cloud infrastructure optimization
* Partner with VP/C-level executives, Product Owners, and Business Units to translate long-term business strategy into actionable technical delivery roadmaps, while overseeing offshore/nearshore partners, SOWs, and vendor contracts
* Direct, mentor, and inspire a high-performing organization of Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous upskilling (including AI-assisted engineering tools like Copilot)

* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), cloud-native design patterns, and serverless architectures
* Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker
* Knowledge of distributed database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, NoSQL)
* Expertise in modern integration technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, API Gateways)
* Proficiency in scaling Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across distributed engineering teams
* Competency in CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and automated testing practices
* Capability to manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets
* Skills in stakeholder management, vendor negotiation, and executive-level communication
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst**
– Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Role: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical R&D Engagement Focus: Current-State Assessment, Gap Analysis, Requirements Definition & Future State Roadmap Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong knowledge of data governance, data licensing, data lifecycle management, and enterprise data management practices to support an assessment of the Data In-Licensing process within Novartis Biomedical Research (NIBR). The individual will work closely with business, scientific research, data management, legal, procurement, compliance, and technology stakeholders to assess the current operating model, identify process and technology gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen governance, compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency across the licensed data lifecycle. Key
**Responsibilities**

1. Data In-Licensing Process Assessment Analyze the end-to-end data in-licensing lifecycle, from data acquisition and contractual agreements through onboarding, provisioning, consumption, renewal, expiry, and retirement. Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops to understand the current operating model, systems, responsibilities, and pain points. Identify manual activities, fragmented workflows, unclear ownership, and opportunities for automation. Prepare AS-IS process maps, gap assessments, and recommended TO-BE workflows.

2. Data Bill of Materials (DBoM) and License Management Define business requirements for a centralized Data Bill of Materials to track all licensed datasets. Identify essential metadata, including data provider, dataset ownership, licensing terms, permitted usage, restrictions, contractual obligations, renewal dates, expiration timelines, and retention requirements. Assess current mechanisms for tracking licensed datasets and their downstream dependencies. Define requirements for notifications, license renewals, compliance checkpoints, and expiry management.

3. Access Governance and Entitlement Management Assess existing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and entitlement management processes. Map user roles, access privileges, approval workflows, and data usage restrictions to contractual requirements. Identify gaps in access approvals, access reviews, and entitlement revocation. Define business requirements for visibility into who accesses licensed datasets, for what purpose, and under which permissions.

4. Data Lifecycle and Retention Management Evaluate existing practices for data retention, archival, expiration, and secure deletion. Translate contractual retention and deletion obligations into actionable business requirements. Identify gaps in handling expired licenses, downstream copies, and derived datasets. Define requirements for deletion workflows, approvals, exception handling, and evidence of deletion.

5. Auditability, Data Lineage, and Compliance Assess the organization's ability to trace licensed data from acquisition to consumption. Define requirements for audit trails, usage monitoring, and end-to-end data lineage. Identify gaps in demonstrating compliance with contractual usage restrictions and internal governance policies. Work with risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to define reporting and audit evidence requirements.

6. Gap Analysis and Future-State Recommendations Consolidate findings into a structured gap assessment covering people, process, technology, and governance. Prioritize gaps based on business impact, contractual exposure, operational risk, and implementation complexity. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized improvement backlog. Collaborate with the Data Engineer and solution architects to define feasible remediation options and a phased implementation roadmap.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• 6–10 years of Business Analysis experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, life sciences, research data, or regulated enterprise environments.

• Experience with data governance, data management, data cataloging, and metadata management.

• Understanding of data licensing, contractual data usage restrictions, and third-party data management.

• Strong knowledge of RBAC, access governance, data lifecycle management, and audit requirements.

• Experience with business process mapping, stakeholder workshops, gap assessments, and requirements documentation.

• Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, data lineage concepts, and enterprise data architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

• Exposure to pharmaceutical R&D or scientific research data ecosystems.

• Experience with data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent.

• Understanding of GDPR, retention policies, contractual compliance, and internal data governance standards.

• Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Visio, or BPMN modeling tools.

**Expected Deliverables**

• Current-State Data In-Licensing Process Assessment.

• Stakeholder and System Interaction Mapping.

• End-to-End Process and Governance Gap Analysis.

• DBoM Business Requirements and Metadata Definition.

• Access Control, Entitlement, Retention, and Deletion Requirements.

• Auditability and Data Traceability Requirements.

• Future-State Process Recommendations.

• Prioritized Business Requirements and Remediation Roadmap. Primary Outcome: A comprehensive understanding of business and governance gaps, with actionable recommendations to establish an efficient, compliant, and traceable data in-licensing process.

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. * Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**About the Role:-**

As a Senior Product Designer, you will play a critical role in shaping the user experience of a modern B2B SaaS platform.

You will be responsible for designing complex product workflows, developing interactive prototypes directly in code, improving shared design systems, and introducing thoughtful interaction patterns for AI-powered experiences.

You will collaborate with US-based stakeholders and design products primarily for a US audience, making strong communication, independent decision-making, and exceptional design judgment essential.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

**1. Product Design & Experience Strategy**

* Lead end-to-end product design initiatives, translating complex business requirements into intuitive user experiences.
* Design sophisticated B2B SaaS interfaces involving data-dense dashboards, tables, forms, permissions, and multi-role workflows.
* Apply strong product thinking, visual hierarchy, usability principles, and interaction design practices.
* Balance user needs, technical feasibility, and business objectives when developing design solutions.

**2. Code-Based Prototyping & Implementation**

* Design and prototype interfaces directly within the existing production codebase using established component libraries and design systems.
* Navigate existing codebases, understand component structures, and assemble functional product interfaces.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about leveraging evolving LLM technology to solve one of Amazon's most fundamental challenges? Do you want to be building the platform that processes over 5 billion customer interactions annually and transforms months of technical work into minutes? As the Principal Product Manager - Technical (PMT) for the Customer Anecdote Miner [CAM] Platform (winner of the 2024 All Amazon Global Door Desk Award), you'll shape the future of how Amazon teams understand and act on customer feedback at unprecedented scale.  
  
We are looking for a Principal PMT who thrives on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems and turning them into clear product strategies that deliver meaningful results at scale. In this role, you will own a multi-year product vision, shape technology investments, and drive cross-organizational alignment to launch products that customers love. You will partner closely with engineering, design, science, and business teams to deconstruct complex challenges into elegant solutions — all while keeping the customer at the centre of every decision. If you are a strategic thinker with deep technical curiosity, a talent for influencing without authority, and a track record of delivering products that matter, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own and drive a multi-year product vision and strategic roadmap, setting direction in ambiguous spaces where the problem, opportunity, and strategy may not yet be defined.
* Lead large, complex product initiatives end-to-end with independence — from concept through launch, scale, and iteration — making high-judgment trade-off decisions with long-term platform and business implications.
* Partner as a technical peer with engineering, applied science, and design teams to evaluate architecture proposals, identify trade-offs others may miss, and ensure solutions are extensible, scalable, and aligned with strategic goals.
* Drive alignment across multiple organizations by influencing senior stakeholders, resolving prioritization conflicts, and building strategic partnerships that shape investment decisions and shared objectives.
* Design experimentation frameworks and define success metrics that distinguish between output and outcome measures, using data, customer research, and emerging technologies including generative AI to accelerate learning and validate product hypotheses.

  
A day in the life  
You'll operate at the intersection of evolving ML technology and real-world business impact. A typical day might include:  
1) Working closely with Amazon teams to understand their feedback analysis needs, and onboarding them as users of CAM  
2) Defining platform features and requirements for upcoming releases  
3) Collaborating with ML Scientists and Engineers to build and optimize our offerings  
4) Analysing platform metrics to identify performance optimization opportunities  
5) Contributing to technical design reviews for new features  
6) Reviewing customer feedback and usage patterns to guide product evolution

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience technical product management
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements

* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders

jobs.description:
**Director Product Management – Customer Data Platform**

**About us:**  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Guest Experience organization. Target is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.

The Customer Data Platform (CDP) Product team is a global organization within Guest Experience that builds Target’s next-generation connected enterprise and guest experience platforms. As Target’s enterprise foundation for trusted, actionable guest and marketing data, the CDP unifies data into reusable profiles and connects upstream sources with downstream decisioning, analytics, personalization, activation, social commerce, and emerging agentic systems. Through Guest Data Foundations, the team enables AI-first, real-time personalization, improves marketing effectiveness, and scales horizontal capabilities across Target with strong governance, reliability, scalability, and privacy—fueling growth and transforming guest experiences through a modern, human-centered, uniquely Target approach.

**About the role:** This Director of Product Management role will be based in Target in India (TII) and will lead a product team in close partnership with leaders and teams across Target.

* **Decisioning & Intelligence:** 30+ models built off the silver and bronze layers, powering data science, AI/ML decisioning, and analytics.
* **Activation & Personalization:** Data and services enabling Audience Platform, personalization models, Next Best Action, experimentation through A/B tests, real-time triggers, and Customer360-powered marketing activations.
* **Marketing Data Centralization:** Centralized marketing data across channels, including DAV, organic and paid social, and search through Funnel.io, enabling stronger channel relationships and unified reporting.
* **Creative & Asset Data Enablement:** Availability of CDMS creative and asset data for activation and performance marketing reporting.

* **ML & Agentic Systems:** Production ML applications with expanding agentic capabilities in partnership with enterprise engineering teams.

As Product Director, you will set the product vision and own the strategy and roadmap for core CDP capabilities, including data sourcing, identity resolution, third-party data, marketing and CRM data assets, guest preferences, sales enablement, and enterprise activation. You will deliver trusted, interoperable products that accelerate value across Target; manage product financials, goals, and OKRs; and ensure the platform meets enterprise standards for reliability, usability, scalability, and modern architecture.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of product managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance through insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback, and partner with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to negotiate priorities and remove execution barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders to validate hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide highly complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialties, using data and analytics to assess product health, evaluate competitive dynamics and P&L impact, inform decisions, and deliver recommendations to key stakeholders.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of product management experience
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing product teams while fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and enterprise collaboration
* Proven experience leading enterprise Customer Data Platform capabilities that unify customer profiles, enable audience creation and activation, support real-time decisioning and personalization, and drive measurable adoption across business teams and channels
* Experience defining strategy and roadmaps for foundational customer data capabilities, including data sourcing and ingestion, identity resolution, unified guest profiles, consent and preference management, CRM data assets, and third-party data integration
* Experience building and scaling data platforms in e-commerce, retail, martec…

**Job Summary**

The candidate will be responsible for developing marketing plans, strengthening brand positioning, driving product visibility, managing digital and offline campaigns, and ensuring marketing initiatives translate into measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate should have strong leadership abilities, excellent execution skills, creative thinking and the ability to take complete ownership of deliverables.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.
* Identify market opportunities, consumer trends and competitor activities.
* Drive brand awareness, customer acquisition and market penetration.
* Develop marketing strategies for existing and new product launches.

**B. Brand Management**

* Maintain consistent brand identity across all marketing channels.
* Plan and execute brand-building campaigns and promotional activities.

* Conceptualize and execute seasonal, festive and product-specific campaigns.

**F. Team & Agency Management**

* Lead and manage the marketing team, ensuring clear task allocation and accountability.
* Set monthly targets, review individual performance and monitor deliverables.
* Coordinate with external agencies, vendors and consultants.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and project closures.
* Maintain professional conduct, team discipline and confidentiality.

**G. Budgeting, MIS & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare and manage the annual and monthly marketing budget.
* Monitor campaign expenditure and marketing ROI.
* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing MIS reports.
* Track campaign performance, engagement, leads and sales contribution.

The performance of the Marketing Manager will be evaluated on:

* Achievement of monthly and quarterly marketing targets.

* Campaign execution within defined timelines.

* Marketing ROI and budget utilization.
* Product launch execution and promotional effectiveness.
* Coordination and support to the sales and distribution teams.
* Timely submission of MIS reports and marketing plans.
* Team productivity, accountability and task closures.
* Innovation and implementation of new marketing initiatives.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field.
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
* 5–8 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in FMCG, Food & Beverage or Consumer Goods.
* Proven experience in brand management, digital marketing and campaign execution.
* Experience in managing teams, external agencies and marketing budgets.
* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, market research and competitor analysis.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong leadership and team management abilities.
* Creative thinking and problem-solving.
* Data-driven decision-making.
* Project management and execution capabilities.
* Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
* Ability to multitask and work within strict deadlines.
* High ownership, accountability and professional integrity.

**Ownership & Accountability**

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, monitoring and closure of all assigned marketing activities.

All projects must have defined timelines, measurable objectives and documented progress. The position requires complete ownership of responsibilities, proactive communication, team accountability and adherence to company policies, confidentiality and professional ethics.

**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
As a Sr. Product Manager on the Strategic Partner Integration team, you will own a defined product area within Docusign’s strategic integrations. Your initial focus will be procurement integrations, connecting agreement workflows to source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes across systems like SAP and other major platforms. You will collaborate closely across customers, partners, Product, Engineering, Sales, and the broader Docusign ecosystem. In this role, you will lead integrations end-to-end—from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. **Description**
Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
  
  
Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
  
  
Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements

**About Auric AI**

Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications

Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error-prone. Our mission is to use AI-powered vision systems to detect and classify high-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.

We’re a fast-moving defense technology startup, combining world-class AI research with real-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.

**The Role**

We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.

This is not a traditional PM role. You will:

* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end-to-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.

**What You’ll Do**

* Vision & Roadmap

1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near-term MVP delivery with long-term platform growth.

* Workflow & UX Design

1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst-ready screens.
3. Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.

* Feature Prioritization

1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must-haves from nice-to-haves.
2. Make trade-offs between speed-to-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.

* Execution & Delivery

1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.

* User & Stakeholder Engagement

1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.

* Metrics & Success

1. Define and track success metrics: time-to-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.

**What We’re Looking For**

* AI-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.

**Why Join Us**

* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission-driven company where AI meets national security.

Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI-native product builder who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager (Device & RASP)
jobs.description:
**About Bureau**
Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
  
  
Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
  
  
**Why Bureau?**
Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
  
  
We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
  
  
**About the Role: Group Product Manager - Device & RASP**
Bureau Device ID creates a persistent, privacy-centered identifier for every device and browser, resilient to factory resets, firmware changes, and incognito mode, with device graphs that expose fraud rings and 160+ signals for behavioral continuity.
  
  
Bureau RASP protects the app from the inside, where sophisticated mobile fraud actually executes. Four Zero Trust layers cover application integrity, runtime and environment threats, network channel protection, and per-threat enforcement, configurable without code changes.
  
  
As Group Product Manager, you will own both products as a single portfolio: strategy, roadmap, detection efficacy, packaging, and the PM team that builds them.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own portfolio strategy for Device Intelligence and Runtime Security, including where the two products converge on a shared SDK, signal set, and enforcement model
* Treat detection efficacy as a product metric, own catch rate, false positive rate, and fingerprint persistence, with labelled datasets, adversarial testing, and regression gates before every release
* Run quarterly planning across Android, iOS, web, backend, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Hold the line on client-side constraints: SDK size, runtime overhead, crash-free rate, OS compatibility, upgrade adoption, and RASP's under-two-minute no-code integration
* Own the privacy posture of device identification — signal minimisation, consent, retention, GDPR/DPDP, and App Store and Play policy, and defend it in customer security reviews
* Own pricing and packaging, standalone and bundled, plus portfolio revenue, adoption, and gross retention
* Equip the field with the demo, POC playbook, and competitive bake-off kit; join strategic deals and escalations

**What You’ll Bring**

* 6-10 years in product management owning a multi-product portfolio
* Depth in fraud and risk, identity, device intelligence, mobile application security, or anti-abuse, with genuine familiarity with attacker techniques
* Experience shipping an SDK or client-side product, and an understanding of why mobile is unforgiving: OS fragmentation, store review, release trains you don't control
* Fluency in detection trade-offs, precision and recall, threshold selection, drift, label quality, and the judgment to spot a weak evaluation
* Technical literacy to read an architecture document, query the data yourself, and hold your own with a security researcher
* Enterprise B2B instincts: security and risk buyers, procurement, vendor security reviews, and POCs that convert
* Exceptional written communication

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

jobs.description:
**Data Management & Governance Program Lead**

**Role summary**

**Job title**

Data Management & Governance Program Lead

**Engagement**

Enterprise data management programme for a life insurer: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI readiness and BAU handover

**Reports to**

Engagement Director - Capvirge; works day to day with the client’s Deputy CTO

**Leads**

Project Manager, Project Coordinator, Data Governance Analyst, Data Quality & Lineage Analyst, Business Analyst, Power BI Developers and Snowflake Data Engineer (with the client EDO team)

**Experience**

12–15+ years in data and analytics; 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes

**Purpose of the role**

The Program Lead designs, gets approved and hands over a complete data management framework, so the business trusts its numbers and can run it without the vendor after Go-Live.

The role owns nine strategic deliverables, from KPI definitions to BAU transition, and steers the client’s EDO team on day-to-day data operations and dashboard delivery. Success means one agreed meaning for every KPI, a named owner for every data asset, proven data quality, and a client team that runs it all on its own.

The role also oversees delivery of the **16 tactical dashboards** (Power BI on Snowflake), from BRD and build to UAT sign-off, Production and BAU.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and frameworks**

* Write and maintain the data management frameworks: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI and automation readiness, handover, committee governance and BAU transition.
* Present frameworks and decision papers to the Steering Committee, the Data Management Committee and the Design Authority, and secure approval at each gate.

**KPIs and data governance**

* Run KPI definition workshops with each department; agree one definition, formula and owner per KPI; build the KPI Dictionary.
* Set up the governance operating model: Data Owners and Stewards, decision rights, policy, standards, data classification and committees.

**Data quality, lineage and platform**

* Identify critical data elements, define quality rules and thresholds, and set up monitoring, issue management and lineage.
* Assess the data platform (Snowflake, AWS, Power BI) for architecture, security, cost and environments; recommend a future state and remediation roadmap.

**Analytics and AI readiness**

* Map customer journeys and funnels; design reusable shared data sets for dashboards and reports.
* Assess AI readiness, rank automation and AI use cases, and set responsible AI and GenAI safety rules.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own the programme plan, RAID log, decision log, evidence repository and status reporting.
* Oversee the dashboard pipeline from BRD to UAT, Production and hypercare; unblock sign-offs with business owners.
* Guide the client EDO team on platform stability, incident and change processes, and the data request SOPs.

**Handover and BAU**

* Design BAU services, SOPs and service levels; train owners, stewards and the EDO team; lead handover acceptance and Go-Live readiness.

**Team the role leads**

**Role**

**Focus**

**Project Manager**

Programme plan, RAID log, action tracker and status reporting

**Project Coordinator**

Meetings, follow-ups, minutes and document control

**Data Governance Analyst**

Data Owners and Stewards, business glossary, policies and standards (D2)

**Data Quality & Lineage Analyst**

Data inventory, quality rules, monitoring and lineage (D3)

**Business Analyst (insurance)**

BRDs, KPI definitions and dashboard requirements (D1, D5)

**Power BI Developers**

Build, UAT and BAU support for the 16 dashboards

**Snowflake Data Engineer**

Data models, pipelines and platform remediation (D4)

**Required experience and qualifications**

* 12–15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes end to end.
* 5+ years in insurance or financial services; life insurance strongly preferred.
* Has set up a data governance operating model (owners, stewards, decision rights, committees) and taken it through executive approval.
* Has standardized KPIs across business units and built a KPI or business glossary used in production reporting.
* Has delivered a data quality programme with critical data elements, rules, thresholds and lineage.
* Has led a platform or architecture assessment and a remediation roadmap on a modern cloud data stack.
* Has handed a programme over to a BAU team, with SOPs, training and acceptance.
* Experience as a consultant or vendor lead working with client executives.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Technical and domain skills**

**Area**

**Must have**

**Good to have**

**Data governance**

DAMA-DMBOK, federated operating models, RACI and decision rights, data classification

DCAM, data catalogue tools

**KPIs and metrics**

KPI trees, SMART definitions, certification and change control

Management scorecards and target setting

**Data quality and lineage**

Critical data elements, quality dimensions, rules and thresholds, issue management, column lineage

Automated quality checks in pipelines (Airflow), logical data models

**Data platforms**

Snowflake, AWS (S3), Power BI; environments, access control, cost (FinOps)

AWS Well-Architected, TOGAF, privileged access (CyberArk)

**Analytics**

Dashboard delivery lifecycle (BRD, UAT, hypercare), semantic models, shared data sets

Customer journey and funnel analytics

**AI readiness**

Use-case scoring; Predictive, Generative and Agentic AI concepts; responsible AI

NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001

**Insurance domain**

Life and ILP products, persistency, APE, claims, IFRS 17 and statutory reporting, bancassurance and digital partners

jobs.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
