jobs.description:
**Job Description**

* Collaborate with developers, product managers, project managers, quality assurance, business teams and technical support to provide a mix of business and technical direction on systems, design, development, testing and deployment.
* Learn stakeholder strategy, tactical approaches, priorities, requirements, and business process.
* Document business requirements and user stories, oversee, and coordinate the development of technical specifications, and help enforce change control procedures.
* Must take initiative to spend time with all levels of users (formal meetings, informal meetings, observing work, etc.)
* May develop and maintain project schedules with appropriate input of project managers and scrum masters, including all necessary activities and dependencies.
* Expected to utilize organizational skills to document, categorize, prioritize, provide easy access to information, ask questions, follow up, and maintain communications.
* Experience with project management tools and methodologies, software development lifecycle and problem solving.
* Demonstrated ability to work on an agile software development team.
* Ability to produce documentation including mockups, flowcharts, and other process diagrams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Familiarity in working in and with cross-functional teams.
* Exhibits strong analytical, problem solving, negotiation, organizational and teaching skills.
* Excellent verbal and non-verbal communication skills. Including the ability to communicate with people at all levels.
* Established subject matter expert covering broad value areas within the Mouser enterprise.
* Demonstrated extensive Mouser business acumen.
* Expert leadership skills in driving agile software development team to successful delivery of projects and initiatives.
* Primary and trusted conduit for internal customers to work with to define their business needs, and document requisite requirements, user stories, and supporting artifacts.
* Requires a bachelor’s degree in a technical or equivalent discipline.

This is a summary of the primary accountabilities and requirements for this position. The company reserves the right to modify or amend accountabilities and requirements at any time at its sole discretion based on business needs. Any part of this job description is subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.
  
  
**About Us**
*Mouser Electronics, founded in 1964, is a globally authorized distributor of semiconductors and electronic components for over 1,200 industry-leading manufacturer brands. We specialize in the rapid introduction of the newest products and technologies targeting the design engineer and buyer communities.
  
  
Mouser has 28 offices located around the globe. We conduct business in 23 different languages and 34 currencies. Our global distribution centre is equipped with state-of-the-art wireless warehouse management systems that enable us to process orders 24/7, and deliver nearly perfect pick-and-ship operations.*

**Enabling a software-defined, electrified future.**
Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
  
  
**Qualification, Experience and Skills:**

* Technical Product Owner for Infotainment in Automotive Domain
* Automotive Infotainment experience of minimum 10 years in the field of IVI technologies
* Shall have Strong experience as Feature Owner / Product Owner with Good Technical Background
* Shall have strong Expertise in managing product backlogs and prioritizing customer needs.
* Shall have Activities at Customer Locations like leading the workshop on feature plan/ technical camps / Delivery workshops.
* Shall have rich Working experience with Scrum and Agile methodology.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, software engineering, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience with software development, infrastructure development, or development and operations related to embedded projects.
* Experience with Developing software for Renesas or similar micro controllers.
* Experience in development languages like C, C++, and others
* Experience in development of CAN & Diagnostics , Audio DSP SW etc
* Good interpersonal skills and communication with all levels of management.
* Able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.

What you will do:
  
  

* Represents the customer, interfaces, and engages the customer (PDTL/Program Manager/PSL/OEM).
* Creates and manages software Feature Implementation Plan with product level plan.
* Creates and maintains the Software Product Backlog.
* Manages external (customer DCRs) and internal change requests through software backlog items.

* Works with systems team, design champion/software architect to create Epics and converts them into stories that are granular enough to be achieved in a single sprint along with acceptance criteria.

* Negotiates budget requirements / expectations with the program management in consultation with the Technical Delivery Manager(s).

Nice to have:
  
  

* Experience with CI/CD tools, Configuration Management, and/or experience with installing,
* Experience participating in Scrum/Kanban, Agile workflow methodologies.
* Certified Agile Product Owner/ Scrum Master.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. At Visteon you can be more.

Aptiv’s passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. jobs.title: Business Analyst, Innovation lab
jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.
  
  
The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
* Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
* Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
* Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
* Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
* Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
* Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
* Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
* Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
* Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
* Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
* Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

jobs.title: Sr Business Systems Analyst - Vertex Implementation
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum 10 years of hands-on Vertex O Series 9.0 implementation and support experience, with configuration expertise in SAP Financial Accounting, Vertex Accelerator, and Vertex O Series 8.0 and 9.0
* Experience with SAP integrations with Vertex, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Sales and Distribution, and Intercompany Invoicing, as well as configuring and troubleshooting SAP Integration Component tax mappings
* Experience supporting global tax implementations across US, Canada, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, Brazil, and India, including greenfield implementations, cutover, hypercare, and production support
* Functional understanding of Sales and Use Tax, VAT/GST, tax exemptions, multi-jurisdiction determination, and global tax matrices, including direct and withholding tax concepts
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, e-invoicing, and Continuous Transaction Controls, including country-specific mandates such as Peppol, LATAM, and India GST
* Highly developed interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms; experience developing and conducting end-user trainings
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with internal business, technical, and external consulting teams; ability to manage projects, teams, and competing priorities under time constraints
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline required
* Vertex O Series certification preferred
* SAP Financial Accounting certification preferred

**Responsibilities**
Serve as the Global Tax lead and single point of accountability for global tax technology, ensuring SAP processes and master data correctly drive tax determination, reporting, and compliance across all jurisdictions.
  
  

* Facilitate the implementation, support, and hands-on configuration of Vertex O Series integration with SAP S/4 HANA, including tax procedures, condition tables, tax codes, jurisdiction codes, and reporting structures
* Design and support tax integration across end-to-end business cycles including Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, intercompany, credit processing, and General Ledger postings
* Support global indirect tax requirements including US Sales and Use Tax, EU VAT, APAC GST, and regional statutory and compliance models, along with direct and withholding tax integration
* Configure, maintain, and validate SAP Integration Component tax mappings; administer exemption and tax certificates within Vertex; and manage taxability codes and jurisdiction setup
* Support Brazil tax implementation and ongoing compliance requirements; participate in Vertex Accelerator and Vertex O Series upgrades including impact assessment, configuration validation, regression testing, deployment coordination, and post-production support
* Own reconciliation and audit readiness by reconciling Vertex tax results to the SAP General Ledger, supporting internal and external audits, and maintaining complete audit trails
* Uphold SOX and change-governance controls, including documentation standards, testing rigor, IT Automated Controls compliance, and disciplined release and change management practices
* Train, coach, and mentor Tax Super Users, Business Process Owners, and Business Process Leads; provide guidance to junior staff on user issues and project-related requests; and drive automation and AI-enabled tax capabilities to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort

**About The Team**
Our SAP Center of Excellence team, part of Moody's Shared Services organization, is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and evolving SAP Finance applications and global tax technology across the enterprise. We partner closely with Tax, Finance, IT, and external advisors to translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable, well-controlled system solutions that power Moody's global operations. By joining our team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how tax technology functions at a global scale, contributing to initiatives spanning multiple regions, business cycles, and compliance frameworks. We are actively investing in automation and AI-enabled capabilities to drive efficiency, accuracy, and innovation across our finance and tax platforms.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
